source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.3 reports a Verilog RTL rewrite for a TPU arithmetic circuit whose optimization objectives were to reduce power and area while preserving functionality; it says the final proposal was required to pass robust verification, the rewrite was validated by TPU designers, was later found by downstream synthesis tools, and was useful at the RTL stage before integration into an upcoming TPU.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can validate a hardware domain gate, hardware_rtl_eda_provenance metadata, and hardware claim-calibration records. It does not claim exact RTL module or arithmetic-circuit identity, real source or modified Verilog/RTL artifacts, synthesis or place-and-route runs, PPA output artifacts, timing/power/area constraints, equivalence-check logs, formal-verification logs, robust verification method identity, designer validation signoff, downstream synthesis confirmation artifacts, RTL-stage timing evidence, standard-language trust or adoption evidence, upcoming-TPU integration target evidence, deployment or time-to-market evidence, or complete artifact hashes and refs.
